name: ObjectMother
summary: A class that builds fully formed objects for tests, so that a test states what matters about its data and nothing else.

reference.author: Peter Schuh and Stephanie Punke
reference.work: ObjectMother: Easing Test Object Creation in XP (XP Universe)

roles.name: ObjectMother
roles.summary: The source of test objects. Each of its methods returns an object already valid and already meaningful — a lapsed subscription, an overdrawn account — named for the SITUATION rather than for the shape, which is what keeps the intent of a test in the test rather than in twenty lines of construction.
